mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees under partly cloudy skies near Fireman's Park. Under the waxing crescent moon, we expect an overnight low of 69 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers. You can help out with various programs, provided you can commit to at least two shifts per month and pass a background check for roles involving seniors.

It is a busy couple of days in our area! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

In a report regarding service calls from earlier in the month, an officer on August 6 conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle driving erratically and subsequently arrested the driver for an O W I, fourth offence.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle. Culver's is open tonight until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
